In Episode 10 (Vector Databases in Practice - Choosing Local Simplicity), we explored: [
  "Yesterday we explored the practical side of vector databases and why starting with local simplicity is often the best approach.",
  "We broke down how managing embeddings locally can dramatically reduce initial infrastructure overhead and speed up prototyping.",
  "Ultimately, scaling up should only happen once your local setup proves it actually needs distributed performance."
]
